items.evidence: Vanilla 1.21.11 has no *_immune_to tags at all (0 entries for all six immune_* tag lookups in the client jar; only wither_immune_to exists, as a damage_type tag). Vanilla immunity is code: the fresh EntityType parse shows 6 literal immuneTo sets (fox -> sweet_berry_bush; polar_bear/snow_golem/stray -> powder_snow; wither/wither_skeleton -> wither_rose). The port's immune_tag (mobs/spawn_rules.rs:179) maps Fox -> minecraft:fox_immune_to etc. - lookups that fail soft, so the six species take damage vanilla spares them. Reproduces from 1.21.7 and 1.21.10.
items.title: immune_tag tags don't exist

items.evidence: Vanilla 1.21.11 EntityType parse: notInPeaceful has 37 members and HOGLIN is absent (it spawns and persists in peaceful); PARCHED is present. The port's allowed_in_peaceful (mobs/spawn_rules.rs:134) excludes Hoglin. Narrowed since 1.21.10: the Parched arm is now correct, only the Hoglin arm is wrong. Reproduces from 1.21.7 and 1.21.10 (narrowed).

items.evidence: Vanilla 1.21.11 Camel.isFood accepts #camel_food; the port's food_tag (mobs/species.rs:1666) has no Camel arm (CamelHusk has camel_husk_food at :1679, Camel has none) - camels cannot breed. Reproduces from 1.21.7 and 1.21.10.
items.title: Camel has no food

items.evidence: Vanilla 1.21.11 Armadillo.getMaxHeadYRot = isScared() ? 0 : 32 (fresh dump Armadillo.txt:776-784). The port's max_head_y_rot (mobs/species.rs:1745) returns 32.0 unconditionally (Species::Armadillo => 32.0 at :1752). Reproduces from 1.21.7 and 1.21.10.

items.evidence: Vanilla 1.21.11 Mob.isSunBurnTick excludes isInWaterOrRain || isInPowderSnow || wasInPowderSnow and gates on the MONSTERS_BURN environment attribute. The port's sun_burn_tick (mobs/ai.rs:2024) computes wet = m.fluids.in_water || in_rain(m, w) (:2035) - no powder snow term at all. The 1.21.10 child fixed this; the 1.21.11 template did not carry the fix. Reproduces from 1.21.7 (was FIXED in 1.21.10).
items.title: Sun-burn ignores powder snow

items.evidence: Vanilla 1.21.11 EntityType parse: canSpawnFarFromPlayer is explicit for exactly two types, PILLAGER and SHULKER. The port's spawns_far_from_player (mobs/spawn_selection.rs:317) returns true for the whole CREATURE and MISC categories. Reproduces from 1.21.7 and 1.21.10.
items.title: Creatures spawn too far from players

items.evidence: Vanilla 1.21.11 NaturalSpawner.getRandomPosWithin: top = getHeight(WORLD_SURFACE)+1, y drawn with randomBetweenInclusive(minY, top) - H+1 is reachable. The port's spawn_category_for_chunk (mobs/spawn_selection.rs:1105-1108) uses top = heightmap(WorldSurface) and draws y in [minY, H]; the port's world_surface (horizon-client-render/src/chunk.rs:724, prime stores highest+1, same convention as vanilla's getHeight), so the port is exactly one level short and the RNG stream diverges on every chunk. Reproduces from 1.21.7 and 1.21.10.
items.title: getRandomPosWithin y-range off by one

items.evidence: Vanilla 1.21.11 always draws nextInt for a pack count, even when min == max. The port's sample_count (mobs/spawn_selection.rs:782) returns entry.min directly when entry.constant, skipping the draw - the RNG stream diverges from vanilla on every constant-count pack. Reproduces from 1.21.7 and 1.21.10.
items.title: Constant-count packs skip an RNG draw

items.evidence: Vanilla 1.21.11 enderman teleport grounds on code - blocksMotion() - not a tag. The port's enderman teleport (mobs/enderman.rs:76,117) grounds on the absent 26.x tag #entities_can_teleport_to (0 entries in either 1.21.11 jar): the ground search never finds a block, so endermen never teleport. Reproduces from 1.21.7 and 1.21.10.
items.title: Endermen never teleport

items.evidence: Same absent tag, second victim: the port's give_morning_gift (mobs/tame.rs:1328) descends from the cat's own position looking for a block tagged #entities_can_teleport_to (:1341) - with the tag absent everywhere, the ground falls to the world bottom and the hop never happens. Two defects in one: the tag grounding (vanilla grounds on blocksMotion()) and the origin - vanilla hops from the LEASH-HOLDER's position (the sleeping owner), the port from the cat's. The gift itself still drops; only the hop is broken. Reproduces from 1.21.7 and 1.21.10.
items.title: Cat morning gift never happens

items.evidence: The port's suffocation rule itself is fixed (_ => MotionFullCollision), but the load path still hard-requires the absent tags: motion.rs:136 suppresses_bounce: tag("minecraft:suppresses_bounce")? and motion.rs:139 causes_suffocation: tag("minecraft:causes_suffocation")? - both tags have 0 entries in the 1.21.11 jars, and the ? fails the whole MotionResources::load, so the client cannot start with prepared 1.21.11 data. items.title: Default suffocation is tag-gated; startup blocker

items.evidence: Vanilla 1.21.11 exempts sleeping mobs from the suffocation check; the port's in-wall check in mobs/ai.rs has no sleeping check, so a sleeping mob inside a block takes suffocation damage. Reproduces from 26.1.2 and 1.21.10.

systemic_note: The systemic thread is the 26.x-form residue in a genuinely adapted template: the 1.21.11 tree fixed five carried defects outright (G02, G08, G16, G18, G36) and narrowed two more (G04: only Hoglin now wrong; G19: only the registered-entity-fluid driver still hardcodes 35723), but the remaining 35 port defects all share one cause - code or data lookups written against the 26.x form (absent tags: #entities_can_teleport_to, #blocks_motion_in_heightmap*, #causes_suffocation, #suppresses_bounce, the immune_* tags; absent classes: AbstractBedBlock, EntityTypes, FarmlandBlock; absent components: mob_visibility; 26.x-only species arms) that silently degrade in 1.21.11 because the lookups fail soft. The two majors are the sharpest instances: G14 (endermen never teleport) and G22 (the suffocation startup blocker, where the lookup fails HARD at load time). Two verdicts run against the child's direction - G09 reproduces in the template (the 1.21.10 child fixed the powder-snow burn exclusion) and G45 re-mints (kinetic weapons exist in 1.21.11) - and G30 widened 18 -> 20 with the two new breedable species. The slice also carries 14 resolved re-check items (5 fixed: G02, G08, G16, G18, G36; 9 closed: G01, G12, G17, G21, G42, G48, O08, O09, O10) per common.md; the withdrawn 1.21.7 oracle group O02 (client.multiplayer - the package exists in 1.21.11's client jar) is recorded in the report only, since its ID is taken by the live constructor-mismatch group.
